reason: The hypothesis takes the reported correlation between nanoprecipitate density and wear resistance in NiX and reframes it as a predictive, testable mechanism, proposing to actively tune precipitate density to optimize wear performance. This goes beyond the paper's descriptive observation by suggesting a controlled intervention and a falsification test, but the core idea and all mechanistic elements are directly extracted from the single source paper.
copied_elements: A2 nanoprecipitates in NiX HEA coating
nanohierarchical architecture with A1, A3, A2 phases
H/E and H3/E2 ratios as indicators of wear resistance
wear tests at room and elevated temperatures
abrasive wear at low temperature, adhesive/oxidative at high temperature
